# Table snapshots, as BigQuery answers. Each case uses a dataset of its own, since a snapshot needs
# a permanent table.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/table-snapshots-intro

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_drop_table;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_drop_table.base (id INT64);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_drop_table.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_drop_table.base;
DROP TABLE scalars_snapshot_drop_table.snap
=> error contains: scalars_snapshot_drop_table.snap which has type SNAPSHOT. A table was expected.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_drop_standard;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_drop_standard.base (id INT64);
DROP SNAPSHOT TABLE scalars_snapshot_drop_standard.base
=> error contains: scalars_snapshot_drop_standard.base which has type TABLE. A snapshot was expected.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_set_options;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_set_options.base (id INT64);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_set_options.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_set_options.base;
ALTER TABLE scalars_snapshot_set_options.snap SET OPTIONS (description = 'changed')
=> error contains: Invalid value: ALTER TABLE SET OPTIONS only supports setting options for tables, while snap is a(n) snapshot

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_add_column;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_add_column.base (id INT64);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_add_column.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_add_column.base;
ALTER TABLE scalars_snapshot_add_column.snap ADD COLUMN extra STRING
=> error contains: Invalid value: ALTER TABLE does not support modifying the schema of a(n) SNAPSHOT: snap

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_replace;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_replace.base (id INT64);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_replace.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_replace.base;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_replace.snap (id INT64)
=> error contains: scalars_snapshot_replace.snap is not allowed for this operation because it currently has type SNAPSHOT.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_insert;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_insert.base (id INT64);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_insert.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_insert.base;
INSERT scalars_snapshot_insert.snap (id) VALUES (1)
=> error contains: scalars_snapshot_insert.snap is a snapshot, and snapshots are immutable.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_update;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_update.base (id INT64);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_update.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_update.base;
UPDATE scalars_snapshot_update.snap SET id = 2 WHERE TRUE
=> error contains: scalars_snapshot_update.snap is a snapshot, and snapshots are immutable.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_delete;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_delete.base (id INT64);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_delete.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_delete.base;
DELETE scalars_snapshot_delete.snap WHERE TRUE
=> error contains: scalars_snapshot_delete.snap is a snapshot, and snapshots are immutable.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_merge;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_merge.base (id INT64);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_merge.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_merge.base;
MERGE scalars_snapshot_merge.snap USING scalars_snapshot_merge.base ON FALSE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id) VALUES (id)
=> error contains: scalars_snapshot_merge.snap is a snapshot, and snapshots are immutable.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_truncate;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_truncate.base (id INT64);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_truncate.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_truncate.base;
TRUNCATE TABLE scalars_snapshot_truncate.snap
=> error contains: scalars_snapshot_truncate.snap is a snapshot, and snapshots are immutable.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_copy;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_copy.base (id INT64);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_copy.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_copy.base;
CREATE TABLE scalars_snapshot_copy.copied COPY scalars_snapshot_copy.snap
=> error contains: scalars_snapshot_copy.snap which has type SNAPSHOT. Allowed types: [TABLE]

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_like;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_like.base (id INT64);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_like.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_like.base;
CREATE TABLE scalars_snapshot_like.liked LIKE scalars_snapshot_like.snap
=> error contains: Invalid value: Cannot CREATE TABLE LIKE `scalars_snapshot_like.snap`, which is SNAPSHOT.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_view;
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars_snapshot_view.v AS SELECT 1 AS id;
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE scalars_snapshot_view.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_view.v
=> error contains: scalars_snapshot_view.v which has type VIEW. Allowed types: [TABLE, SNAPSHOT]

# A snapshot takes the base table's description and labels but not its expiration, and OPTIONS
# replace them.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_inherited;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_inherited.base (id INT64) OPTIONS (description = 'base', friendly_name = 'Base', labels = [('env', 'dev')], expiration_timestamp = TIMESTAMP '2100-01-01 00:00:00 UTC');
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_inherited.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_inherited.base OPTIONS (friendly_name = 'Snap');
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(option_name, option_value) ORDER BY option_name)) FROM scalars_snapshot_inherited.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS WHERE table_name = 'snap'
=> "[{\"option_name\":\"description\",\"option_value\":\"\\\"base\\\"\"},{\"option_name\":\"friendly_name\",\"option_value\":\"\\\"Snap\\\"\"},{\"option_name\":\"labels\",\"option_value\":\"[STRUCT(\\\"env\\\", \\\"dev\\\")]\"}]"

# A snapshot of a snapshot names that snapshot as its base table.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_of_snapshot;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_of_snapshot.base (id INT64);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_of_snapshot.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_of_snapshot.base;
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_of_snapshot.copied CLONE scalars_snapshot_of_snapshot.snap;
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(table_type, base_table_name)) FROM scalars_snapshot_of_snapshot.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE table_name = 'copied'
=> "{\"table_type\":\"SNAPSHOT\",\"base_table_name\":\"snap\"}"

# A snapshot of a temporary table names the job's project and a dataset of the script's.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_temporary;
CREATE TEMP TABLE t (id INT64);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_temporary.snap CLONE t;
SELECT FORMAT('%t %t %s', base_table_catalog = @@project_id, STARTS_WITH(base_table_schema, '_script'), base_table_name) FROM scalars_snapshot_temporary.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_SNAPSHOTS
=> "true true t"

# A table restored from a snapshot lists even empty friendly_name and labels in TABLE_OPTIONS.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_restored;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_restored.base (id INT64) OPTIONS (description = 'base');
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scalars_snapshot_restored.snap CLONE scalars_snapshot_restored.base OPTIONS (expiration_timestamp = TIMESTAMP '2100-01-01 00:00:00 UTC');
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_snapshot_restored.restored CLONE scalars_snapshot_restored.snap;
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(t.table_type, t.base_table_name, ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT option_name, option_value FROM scalars_snapshot_restored.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS WHERE table_name = 'restored' ORDER BY option_name) AS options)) FROM scalars_snapshot_restored.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES AS t WHERE t.table_name = 'restored'
=> "{\"table_type\":\"BASE TABLE\",\"base_table_name\":null,\"options\":[{\"option_name\":\"description\",\"option_value\":\"\\\"base\\\"\"},{\"option_name\":\"friendly_name\",\"option_value\":\"\\\"\\\"\"},{\"option_name\":\"labels\",\"option_value\":\"[]\"}]}"
